podcast.title: Mike Smith's Role as Bubbles
podcast.body: Mike Smith, formerly the guitarist for Sandbox, co-founded The Trailer Park Boys and achieved widespread fame by playing the character Bubbles. This venture launched a successful career in television and comedy for him. "Mike Smith... made up with a couple of other guys and founded the trailer park boys."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Mike Smith's Post-Band Career (Trailer Park Boys)
xref.body: Guitarist Mike Smith transitioned from music to acting and comedy, co-founding The Trailer Park Boys and becoming widely known for his portrayal of the character Bubbles in the Sunnyvale trailer park series. This represents a significant career shift. "then there's guitarist Mike Smith. He's doing fine. He made up with a couple of other guys and founded the trailer park boys."

xref.title: Mike Smith's Transition to Bubbles
xref.body: Mike Smith, a guitarist for Sandbox, took a job as a sound man in movies and television after the band's breakup. He developed a character using a pair of very thick glasses that a girlfriend found for him in a Texas flea market. While goofing around on the set of the 1999 movie "The Trailer Park Boys," everyone liked the character so much that they wrote Mike into the movie, leading him to become "Bubbles, the trailer park boy." "Mike Smith, one of the guitarists, took a job as a sound man in movies and television. He had this character that he did using a pair of really thick glasses, a girlfriend found for him in a Texas flea market. And we'll goofing around on the set of a 1999 movie called The Trailer Park Boys. Everyone really liked the character so much that they wrote Mike into the movie. And this is how Mike Smith guitarist from the Juno nominated Sandbox became Bubbles, the trailer park boy who now sings songs like..."
